title: SiteFlow vs Buildertrend: Detailed Feature Comparison for Builders
metaTitle: SiteFlow vs Buildertrend: Detailed Feature Comparison for Builders
metaDescription: Compare SiteFlow and Buildertrend across BOQ-linked cost control, approvals, attendance, and India-Gulf workflows. SiteFlow is execution-first; Buildertrend is built for residential client workflows.
author: SiteFlow Operations Team
body: SiteFlow is an execution-first construction ERP built around BOQ-driven cost control, multi-level approvals, and live site visibility. Buildertrend is a residential and client-portal focused platform for US homebuilders. The structured comparison block below is the authoritative breakdown of capabilities across both platforms.

hero.headline: SiteFlow vs Buildertrend: Construction Software Comparison
hero.subhead: Buildertrend is built for residential contractors and custom homebuilders, especially in the US. SiteFlow is built for execution-first teams that tie every site activity to cost control, BOQ-linked billing, and live P&L.

verdict.name: SiteFlow
points: Real-time cost control: site entries update budgets and billing immediately
Face recognition and GPS attendance with automated wage calculation
Native Tally and Zoho Books sync with INR pricing for India and Gulf

verdict.name: Buildertrend
points: Homeowner portal, client selections, and residential sales workflow
Estimate-based budgeting decoupled from live site activity
Basic approval routing for simpler residential needs

approaches.label: Approach
approaches.title: SiteFlow: BOQ-linked execution control
approaches.body: SiteFlow connects every procurement decision, labour deployment, and cost entry back to the original BOQ, keeping financial movement visible while the project is still running.

approaches.label: Approach
approaches.title: Buildertrend: client-first residential workflow
approaches.body: Buildertrend centres on client portals and residential sales workflows, with budgeting that is decoupled from live site data and often reconciled manually.

whatIs.name: SiteFlow
whatIs.body: SiteFlow is a mobile-first construction ERP built around BOQ-driven execution, cost control, and live site visibility, connecting scope, scheduling, progress, labour, procurement, vendor billing, and finances into one workflow.
bullets: Tally and Zoho Books native sync

whatIs.name: Buildertrend
whatIs.body: Buildertrend is a construction management platform for residential contractors and custom homebuilders, focused on client communication, sales, and homeowner-facing workflows.

faqs.q: What is the main difference between SiteFlow and Buildertrend?
faqs.a: SiteFlow is an execution-first ERP for contractors focused on BOQ compliance, multi-level approvals, and real-time financial tracking. Buildertrend is a client-first platform for residential homebuilders prioritising client communication and sales workflows.

faqs.q: Does SiteFlow support multi-level approval workflows?
faqs.a: Yes. SiteFlow offers configurable multi-tier approval routing for purchase orders, payments, and major project changes, which is essential for larger operations with strict compliance requirements.

faqs.q: Which platform is better for Indian construction companies?
faqs.a: SiteFlow is architected for the Indian and Middle Eastern markets, with native integrations to Tally and Zoho Books and INR-based pricing built for local workflows.
